entries.text:
Using infrared, you can battle and trade
with a friend in front of you.
You can also use the Feeling Check which
tells you how compatible you and your
friend are, and exchange Friend Codes.

By pressing the Game Sync button,
you can select a Pokémon to make sleep
and then send your saved data over
Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection.

You cannot connect to Nintendo Wi-Fi
Connection without the proper
system settings, even when you are
able to receive a signal for 
Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection.

DS Wireless Communications
allow you to use the features below
with your nearby friends.
-Xtransceiver
-Entralink

The Xtransceiver allows you to connect
with friends you've played with in the
Wi-Fi Club or those you've exchanged
Friend Codes with using the C-Gear.

Press the button, and you will be
sent to the Entralink instantly.

You can tell how many people
are in the Union Room around you
and if wireless distributions
are available nearby.

You can also tell who has
the C-Gear turned on around you.
When people are nearby,
it is easier to receive signals for
the Tag Log and Survey Radar.

It displays what people
around you are doing in real time.
By selecting it, you can find out
more about them and send
them messages.

You can do surveys on people
around you.

Choose what you want to find out,
and you can see the daily results,
as well as the cumulative results.

Touch the Customization icon, and it will
start blinking. Touch other buttons as it
blinks, and they will appear differently.

You can even make patterns with buttons
of different colors.

Touch this button to turn
wireless communications on or off.

Once you turn it off, the touch panel
turns dark, and wireless communications
will be turned off.
